notes.title: Wanech's C.A.N. Announced!
notes.content: [p]Hi folks, I'm announcing the release of a new, FREE game! Here is what that is all about:[/p][p align="start"]After wrapping up the hit Amborettio, Wanech transformed his trusty C.A.N. into a cozy green-themed pub serving brew, burgers, fries, and wings. The place hums with synthwave tracks, punctuated by chiptune sound effects, giving it a playful retro vibe.[/p][p align="start"]In this top-down, casual cooking sim with arcade twists, you’ll serve hungry customers by cooking food in a unique way: as meals rain down the screen, hit the correct W, A, S, D keys in sequence to prepare each order. Master the rhythm of the kitchen and deliver every plate![/p][p align="start"]Nobody really knows why Wanech traded adventure for appetizers—though rumor has it, it’s all to raise awareness for Amborettio. Whatever the reason, your mission is clear: keep the pub buzzing, the customers smiling, and the orders flowing![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3958040/Wanechs_CAN/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink]You can check out the game below:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2mYQTsESqo4"][/dynamiclink]-Wanech[/p]
